chapter: Studio recordings of the late twenties and thirties
title: Sam Lanin's several bands
summary: Kline asks how Sam Lanin ran multiple bands under his name; Morehouse does not remember which he was in.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: A year after, okay. Tell me about Sam Lanin. You played with Sam Lanin. What kind of a group, what was his setup? Didn't he have more than one band?
Sam Lanin. Didn't he have several bands, different bands?
Tell me about that. How did that work? Were you with more than one band of his?
Yeah, I was with this group here.
Yeah, you were with several - some of his bands or one band?
Okay. And as I understand it, he had different bands working under his name.
